description: Easy - Basic Concepts of SSL and Domains

questions.question: What does HTTPS stand for?
options: HyperText Transfer Protocol Secured
High Transfer Protocol System
HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure
Hosted Transfer Protocol Standard

questions.question: What is TLS?
options: A type of DNS record used for email security
The encryption layer added on top of HTTP in HTTPS
A tool used to renew SSL certificates automatically
A protocol for transferring files between servers

questions.question: What is a Certificate Authority (CA)?
options: A server that hosts your website and manages traffic
A DNS provider that manages your domain records
A trusted organisation that verifies domain ownership and issues SSL certificates
A tool that automatically renews expired certificates

questions.question: What is Let's Encrypt?
options: A paid certificate authority used by large enterprises
A free Certificate Authority that offers automated certificate issuance and renewal
A tool for generating self-signed certificates for production use
A DNS provider that also issues SSL certificates

questions.question: How long are Let's Encrypt certificates valid for?
options: 1 year
2 years
90 days
30 days

questions.question: What tool is commonly used to obtain and renew Let's Encrypt certificates?
options: OpenSSL
Certbot
nslookup
Nginx

questions.question: What does a self-signed certificate mean?
options: A certificate signed by a trusted Certificate Authority
A certificate that never expires
A certificate you generate yourself without a CA signing it
A certificate valid for all subdomains of a domain

questions.question: What is a wildcard certificate?
options: A certificate valid for any domain on the internet
A certificate that covers a domain and all its subdomains
A certificate issued without domain validation
A temporary certificate used during local development

questions.question: What port does HTTPS traffic use by default?
What does the padlock icon in a browser indicate?
options: The site is government-owned and verified
The connection is encrypted and the server identity has been verified
The site has passed a security audit by the browser vendor
The site uses HTTP and is safe to use
